name: @hobo/data-postgres
description: HoBo provider-neutral PostgreSQL authoring surface: the postgres.database() capability requirement builder for data.postgres/v1, the structured feature/guarantee vocabulary a Postgres product advertises, a declarative conformance suite that proves the advertised subset with injected executors, and the migration.postgres.pg-dump/v1 plus migration.postgres.logical-copy/v1 profiles with pure argv builders that keep credentials off the command line.
